output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[holder] += value; totalSupply += value; checks are bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value); balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value); allowed[_from][msg.sender] = allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value); checks are bypassed if _value is crafted to overflow.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; checks are bypassed if _value is crafted to overflow.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue); checks are bypassed if _addedValue is crafted to overflow.

The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The oldValue is greater than _subtractedValue, the allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); checks are bypassed if _subtractedValue is crafted to overflow.
